cases.title: Allegation of hazing
cases.text:
A former Bats player alleged in an interview that veterans pressured rookies into paying for team events. The complaint involves money rookies were asked to pay.

The league's workplace policy bars hazing in any form.

options.label: Open a formal investigation, rule on the findings

cases.title: Bench-clearing incident
cases.where: Palm Creek Leatherbacks at Bruca Beach Hammerheads, week 2
cases.text:
A late hit led to a bench-clearing scrum in the third quarter. Lomano Toatele (Hammerheads) and Sergei Mladenko (Leatherbacks) were singled out by officials. Order was restored in under a minute.

Both head coaches have been asked to speak with the commissioner's staff.
